statement: For every uniform Boolean f and coordinate i, with restriction spectra P=a^2,Q=b^2,R=(P+Q)/2 and q=(a-b)^2/(2(a^2+b^2)), the restriction entropy increment equals JS(P,Q)+sum R h(q).
proof_or_counterexample: Parent coefficient pair is (a+b)/2,(a-b)/2 with squared marginal R. Apply finite entropy chain rule, then subtract average child entropy. A two-bit disjoint-spectrum witness has Delta=2, B=1, JS=1.
remaining_gap: Independent audit pending; this identity does not bound the conditional term by influence.

statement: For every uniform Boolean f and coordinate i, 0<=JS(P,Q)<=(2/ln2)Inf_i(f) and B_i<=Delta_i<=h(Inf_i(f))+(2/ln2)Inf_i(f).
proof_or_counterexample: Scalar Jensen-Shannon contribution in nats is <=(sqrt(x)-sqrt(y))^2/2, proved by differentiating in u=(x-y)/(x+y) and atanh(u)<=u/sqrt(1-u^2). Sum, use (|a|-|b|)^2<=(a-b)^2, and use Jensen concavity for B.
remaining_gap: The binary-entropy upper bound retains log(1/Inf_i); independent audit pending.

statement: For every even m>=2 there is a Boolean F_m on m+1 uniform bits with selector influence 2^-m and selector entropy-increment/influence ratio at least m-1. Thus a universal arbitrary-coordinate restriction bound is false.
assumptions: F_m restricts on selector to g and h
proof_or_counterexample: The bent Walsh coefficients are signs times N^-1/2, N=2^m. Parent selector coefficients are N^-1 and no-selector coefficients are ghat-N^-1. Marginals >=1/(2N), so conditional probabilities <=2/N. Conditional entropy >=(m-1)/N; JS>=0.
remaining_gap: Does not refute existence of a good coordinate or the full FEI conjecture; independent audit pending.

statement: For every tau>0 and every M>0, there is a uniform Boolean f with all individual influences <=tau and some coordinate v with Delta_v(f)/Inf_v(f)>=M.
assumptions: Replace every outer rare-switch input by disjoint balanced odd-majority gadgets
proof_or_counterexample: All physical influences are alpha times their outer influence by independence of disjoint blocks. For v, influence is alpha/N. Empty remaining-selector Fourier indices contribute at least alpha^2*m/N to conditional entropy: a common multiplicative coefficient cancels from q, q<=4alpha^2/N<=1/N, and Parseval gives sum c_U^2=1 in each activated-block sector. L1 implies Delta>=B, hence ratio>=alpha*m.
remaining_gap: Only one bad coordinate is shown, not all; no FEI disproof and no chosen-coordinate solution. Independent audit pending.

statement: For any complete uniform Boolean restriction tree, sum_v 2^-depth(v) B_v <= H(f) <= sum_v 2^-depth(v) B_v+(2/ln2)I(f). A dimension-free upper bound on that aggregate B budget is equivalent to FEI up to an additive constant.
assumptions: Each branch fixes one unfixed coordinate
Every leaf is a constant Boolean function
proof_or_counterexample: Telescope the entropy increments and the total-influence restriction identity; leaves have zero entropy and influence. Apply L1 and L2 node by node with the actual tree weights.
remaining_gap: The dimension-free aggregate conditional-entropy budget is the single hardest remaining gap; independent audit pending.

statement: For every tau>0 and M>0, there is a uniform Boolean f with H(f)<=4I(f), with all individual influences <=tau, and with some coordinate v satisfying Delta_v(f)/Inf_v(f)>=M.
assumptions: f=F_m(G_d,...,G_d) using disjoint balanced iterated majority-of-three gadgets
proof_or_counterexample: Balanced disjoint block composition has H=H(F)+I(F)H(G), I=I(F)I(G). For G_d, I=beta=(3/2)^d, H=4(beta-1), every leaf influence alpha. Outer F_m has I=m/2+(m+1)/2^m and H<=m+1<=3I. Thus H(f)<=(4-1/beta)I(f)<=4I(f). L4's empty-selector-sector argument applies with alpha=2^-d and gives Delta_v/Inf_v>=alpha*m.
remaining_gap: Independent audit pending; this is a special family. A general aggregate entropy budget for arbitrary Boolean functions is still missing.
